text: Actually, could we talk a little more about my project first? It'll help me relax more while we're fishing.

text: Alright, tell me all about it. We can prep the rods and have some fun together at the same time.

text: I hope we catch a big one today! It's always exciting to see what the water has in store for us.

text: I remember catching a huge fish here once, it was quite the adventure!
